name: ob1-dashboard
comment: The operator GUI (SMD-2280): a SvelteKit server, a client of the REST core through ../rest-client, served at /dashboard by the stack's proxy. Built into the server image (server-portable/Dockerfile) and run there as compose's `app` service, `bun ../dashboard/serve.ts`. Every package is a build-time one: adapter-node bundles what the server needs into build/, so the image installs nothing for it. Pinned exactly, as the other servers' packages are.
